title: AddressBook/query args
description: Arguments for AddressBook/query (RFC 9610 §5.4). Returns an ordered list of AddressBook ids matching a filter.

accountId.description: The account to query address books from.

sort.description: Sort criteria. Each Comparator has a property (e.g. name) and optional isAscending (default true).

position.description: 0-based index of the first result to return.

anchor.description: An AddressBookId to anchor the result page at.

anchorOffset.description: Offset from the anchor (may be negative).

limit.description: Maximum number of ids to return.

calculateTotal.description: If true, return the total number of matching address books.
